sources.title: Upgraded Toyota bZ4X family expanded with larger, more powerful all-new Touring grade (Toyota Australia news)
sources.supports: Re-opened 2026-11-05. '2026 Toyota bZ4X pricing': 2WD $55,990, AWD $67,990, Touring $69,990; 'from $69,990 plus on-road costs' for Touring. This is a dated news article, not a live price list.

sources.title: Toyota PressRoom: HiLux BEV (added 31-03-2026)
sources.supports: Re-opened 2026-11-05. '2026 Toyota HiLux BEV pricing': SR double cab-chassis $74,990; SR double-cab pick-up $76,490; SR5 double-cab pick-up $82,990, as manufacturer's list prices provided for media purposes, plus on-road costs. This is a dated press release, not a live price list.

sources.title: bZ4X charging offer terms and conditions (Toyota Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Last updated 7 May 2026. Retail customers who order and take delivery of a bZ4X or HiLux BEV (all grades) between 10 December 2025 and 31 December 2026 may choose a complimentary 7 kW Jet Charge home wall charger (installation not included) or up to 12 months of Chargefox charging capped at 625 kWh; subject to availability, eligibility and registration steps before 31 January 2027.

sources.title: Toyota current offers
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. bZ4X offers listed include a $5,000 Plate Clearance Bonus on bZ4X 2WD and AWD models built 1 January to 31 December 2026 (and two other bZ4X offers); no bZ4X price change stated.

availability.note: bZ4X is still listed with current offers; order status and stock not stated.
